message.content: {"accepted_predicates":[{"name":"EXPLAINS_ARTIFACT_BEHAVIOR_FROM_SOURCE","definition":"The reasoning explains how an artifact realizes its behavior—including differing behavior across execution contexts—by interpreting specific source constructs present in an observation of the artifact's content.","parameters":[{"name":"explanation_reasoning","type":"reasoning","description":"The reasoning node interpreting source constructs to explain the artifact's behavior."},{"name":"source_observation","type":"observation","description":"The observation containing the artifact or source content being interpreted."}],"assertion_conditions":["The observation contains source or artifact content.","The reasoning references at least one specific construct, block, directive, or code element in that content.","The reasoning explains how that construct causes or enables the artifact's behavior, including, where relevant, its differing behavior across execution contexts."],"exclusion_conditions":["The reasoning only summarizes test results, restates content, or describes behavior without tying it to specific source constructs.","The observation does not contain source or artifact content.","The reasoning references no concrete source construct."]}],"revised_existing_predicates":[]}
